description: Pyth Network oracle prices with confidence bands, read on-chain from Pyth's Solana push feeds: price, confidence interval (absolute and %), EMA price and EMA confidence, publish time and age in seconds, feed id and account, for up to 20 symbols (BTCUSD, ETHUSD, SOLUSD, gold XAUUSD, stablecoins, LST rates; ~65 feeds). Call with list=true for every available symbol. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

list.description: true to list the available symbols instead

symbols.description: Comma-separated Pyth symbols, e.g. BTCUSD,ETHUSD (1 to 20)
